summary: Iteration 92 - All 5 new MAARS Infinity features fully tested and working: 1) Semantic Memory Layer, 2) Worker Queues, 3) WebSocket Streaming, 4) Multi-Environment Segregation, 5) Custom Alert Rules CRUD. Backend: 26/26 tests pass (100%). Frontend: Observability Dashboard shows Alert Rules panel with create/edit/delete/toggle functionality, Commander Orion shows WebSocket Live Stream badge.

semantic_memory_store.details: POST /api/infinity/memory/semantic/store - stores semantic concepts with concept_type, description, related_entities, confidence, tags

semantic_memory_query.details: POST /api/infinity/memory/semantic/query - queries across concepts, episodes, and knowledge graph entities

semantic_memory_agent_context.details: POST /api/infinity/memory/semantic/agent-context - builds rich agent context for runtime with semantic_context, concepts_found, episodes_found

semantic_memory_get_concept.details: GET /api/infinity/memory/semantic/concept/{concept} - retrieves single concept by name

worker_enqueue_job.details: POST /api/infinity/workers/enqueue - enqueues background jobs (llm_execution, search_and_report, batch_analysis, agent_runtime)

worker_list_jobs.details: GET /api/infinity/workers/jobs - lists jobs with optional status and job_type filters

worker_get_job.details: GET /api/infinity/workers/jobs/{job_id} - retrieves single job status with progress, result, error

worker_cancel_job.details: POST /api/infinity/workers/jobs/{job_id}/cancel - cancels queued or running jobs

worker_queue_stats.details: GET /api/infinity/workers/stats - returns total_jobs, active_workers, by_status, by_type

environments_list.details: GET /api/infinity/environments - lists all 4 environments (production, staging, sandbox, simulation)

environments_active.details: GET /api/infinity/environments/active - returns active environment with config

environments_stats.details: GET /api/infinity/environments/stats - returns execution stats per environment

environments_validate.details: POST /api/infinity/environments/validate - validates execution in environment with autonomy_tier and model checks

environments_configure.details: POST /api/infinity/environments/configure - stores custom environment overrides (rate_limit_rpm, max_autonomy_tier, etc.)

alert_rules_list.details: GET /api/infinity/alerts/rules - lists all alert rules including custom rules

alert_rules_create.details: POST /api/infinity/alerts/rules - creates new custom alert rule with rule_id, name, metric, operator, threshold, severity, enabled

alert_rules_delete.details: DELETE /api/infinity/alerts/rules/{rule_id} - deletes alert rule and associated alerts

alert_rules_duplicate_rejected.details: POST /api/infinity/alerts/rules - correctly rejects duplicate rule_id with 400 error

runtime_semantic_memory_integration.details: POST /api/infinity/runtime/execute - step 3 (retrieve_memory) uses semantic memory via build_agent_context

runtime_environment_validation.details: POST /api/infinity/runtime/execute - step 1.5 validates environment before execution

frontend_observability_alert_rules_panel.details: Observability Dashboard shows Alert Rules panel with 9 rules, custom badges, toggle/edit/delete buttons, + New Rule button

frontend_alert_rule_create_modal.details: Create Alert Rule modal has Rule ID, Rule Name, Metric dropdown, Operator dropdown, Threshold input, Severity dropdown, Enabled checkbox, Cancel/Create buttons

frontend_commander_websocket_badge.details: Commander Orion shows 'Live Stream' WebSocket status badge when connected

frontend_observability_live_badge.details: Observability Dashboard shows 'Live' badge and 'Operational' status

frontend_metrics_trend.details: Metrics Trend section shows Agent Utilization %, Min Model Success %, Open Incidents sparklines

critical_code_review_comments: All 5 new features are fully implemented and working with NO MOCKS
Semantic memory layer integrates with agent runtime step 3 (retrieve_memory) via build_agent_context()
Environment validation integrates with agent runtime step 1.5 via validate_execution_environment()
Worker queue auto-processes jobs in background via asyncio.create_task()
WebSocket streaming broadcasts step updates, metrics, alerts, and job progress
Custom alert rules support full CRUD with duplicate detection
All data-testid attributes present on UI elements for testing
seed_data_creation: Created test semantic concepts (TEST_concept_*, TEST_single_concept_*), test alert rules (test_rule_*, test_update_rule_*, test_delete_rule_*, test_dup_rule_*), and test worker jobs during testing. All test data uses TEST_ prefix for identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 92 tested 5 NEW features: 1) Semantic Memory (POST store/query/agent-context, GET stats/concept/{name}), 2) Worker Queues (POST enqueue, GET jobs/stats, POST cancel), 3) WebSocket Streaming (GET ws/stats, WS /api/ws/infinity), 4) Multi-Environment (GET environments/active/stats, POST set/validate/configure), 5) Custom Alert Rules CRUD (POST/PUT/DELETE /alerts/rules). Frontend Observability Dashboard has Alert Rules panel with create/edit/delete/toggle. Commander Orion has WebSocket Live Stream badge. All previous MAARS Infinity features from iterations 87-91 still work.
